title: PerPlayer PVP
description: Lets individual players decide if they want PVP enabled.
body:
![A red banner that says "P2 PVP"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf40a60d2981e5c5cf4aeb54888df78d7feb945d_0.webp) PerPlayer PVP _(or P2 PVP for short)_ is a simple plugin that ensures that both parties consent to PVP before it can commence. # Features * Toggling own PVP * Toggling others PVP * Toggleable modes (receiving or shared) * Easy onboarding for players by default ![A red banner that says "Usage"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77a855f9581674289bdf69adef6350e0830d0600_0.webp) ## Toggle PVP In order to toggle PVP simply run the `/pvpToggle` command with your choice of PVP being either true or false (true: on, false: off).
--- **Toggling others PVP**
You can toggle PVP for other players using the same `/pvpToggle ` command from above but by prepending a username onto the end so it becomes `/pvpToggle `.
_Note: This currently only works with players that are online, offline player support is soon™_
_Permission required: `p2pvp.edit` while notifying players with `p2pvp.edit.invisible` doing so without notification_ ## Edit Config Config can be edited using the `/pvpManage` command followed by the option to edit or `reload`to load the config from the plugins `config.yml` file. The syntax for the command is as follows:
* Loading from `config.yml`: `/pvpManage reload` * Viewing the current value of a config: `/pvpManage
